thread:
Eve (CEO): Good morning team — quick weekly note from me. High level: we need to close the gap on latency, get Private GA over the line next week, and keep costs within the new targets.
Eve (CEO): Priorities for this week: 1) SLA hardening for Dedicated (p99 goal), 2) Private GA checklist + comms, 3) cost reduction runway (12% target M/M).
Eve (CEO): Metrics snapshot: uptime 99.95%, p95 gen latency ~180ms, infra spend trending +6% month-to-date (we need to reverse this).
Priya (VP Product): For Private GA: marketing has the comms draft ready. Need eng confirmation on the final rollout gating checklist by EOD Wed.
Marco (VP Eng): On SLA: team will prioritize the p99 regression. Plan is: canary rollout at 5% today, expand to 20% tomorrow if no regressions; fallback plan ready.
Marco (VP Eng): Regarding Private GA checklist: tagging items as DONE/IN-PROGRESS in #release-war-room now. Will confirm EOD Wed.
Sam (Head of Ops): Ops note: we ran a minor KV cache eviction incident Friday — symptomatic load spike + suboptimal cache eviction thresholds. RCA: tuned thresholds, added a short-term prefix cache, and queued a longer-term fix into the backend sprint. Incident didn't breach customer SLAs but caused a handful of 504s.
Eve (CEO): Thanks Sam — circle back in standup with an owner and ETA for the backend sprint fix. Make sure we have an automated smoke test for prefix cache behavior before GA.
Marco (VP Eng): Assigned owner (Aman) and ETA is 2 sprints. I'll add the smoke test to the canary gate.
Jen (CFO): Cost side: we're flagging a hiring slowdown and a temporary reduction in contractor spend. That should give runway to meet the 12% reduction target if engineering lands batching and quantization suggestions.
Priya (VP Product): Product asks: list of customer-facing features for first GA wave is frozen — no last-minute additions unless security or legal requires it.
Eve (CEO): Quick asks: @Marco please confirm canary rollback steps in <#release-war-room> and @Priya confirm comms schedule (internal + customers).
Marco (VP Eng): Confirmed. Rollback artifact is at s3://redwood-release/artifacts/1746504321-rollback and runbook updated.
Priya (VP Product): Comms schedule: internal heads at 10:30 PT Tue, customer email Wed 11:00 PT, blog + changelog Thu morning.
Sam (Head of Ops): Oncall reminder: we move to the new rotation Fri 00:00 PT — paging config updated. Also posting the post-incident follow-up doc in #incidents later today.
Jen (CFO): One ask for the execs: consolidate any mid-quarter asks by Friday so we can review budget impacts for Qx adjustments.
Eve (CEO): Appreciated. If anything blocks Private GA, flag to me directly. Small wins this week: strong stability numbers, but let's finish the three asks above.
Marco (VP Eng): :thumbsup:
Priya (VP Product): :raised_hands: will confirm timings.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy started at 2024-11-12T16:05:00Z for release v2.3.7 — target 5% traffic. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/v2.3.7
Eve (CEO): Closing note: heads-down execution. I'll do a quick sync with Priya and Marco Wed morning to clear blockers. Thanks everyone.
